Dear group members,

I am wondering how to work with factors in unmarked.
I have a model with a factor but when I use the function backTransform I got the message:

> backTransform(mod6, "state")
Error en .local(obj, ...) :
  Cannot directly backTransform an unmarkedEstimate with length > 1.

mod6 is a model with factor (0 and 1).  Should I make the vector as a factor?

Best,
